welcome.title: Welcome to TRAN Voting
welcome.subtitle: Select your role to continue into the application:

deleteAccountConfirm.title: Delete your account?
deleteAccountConfirm.body: Your account and its data will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone, and nothing can be recovered.

deletionPage.title: Deleting your TRAN Voting account
deletionPage.intro: You can delete your account yourself, at any time, from inside the app. You do not need to write to us or fill in a form.
deletionPage.stepOpen: Open TRAN Voting on the web, on iPhone or on Android, and sign in.
deletionPage.stepChoose: Choose “{deleteAction}”. It is next to “{signOutAction}” on every signed-in screen.
deletionPage.stepConfirm: Confirm. Your account is deleted as soon as the server confirms it, and every device that used it is signed out.
deletionPage.deletedBody: Your account and everything the server holds for it, including your sign-ins on every device. Deletion is permanent: it cannot be undone and nothing can be recovered.
deletionPage.keptTitle: What is kept, and for how long
deletionPage.keptBody: Nothing. No copy of your account or its data is kept after deletion, so there is no retention period. The server records only that a deletion happened, never whose account it was.
deletionPage.openApp: Open the web app to delete your account
